text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high pending allocate queue in aws-ap-east-1 affecting inference pools — prob: quota/limit hit causing scale-up failures. Bridge: https://call/12345 (auto)
matt (oncall): ACK. seeing big queue on the autoscaler metric. rooting into logs now. ETA 10m.
ashley (sre): Confirming: allocator errors show API 403 / QuotaExceeded from AWS Batch/node-claims when requesting g4dn-type. Sample: `Error: Request limit exceeded` in controller logs.
lee (cloud): Jumping in — looks like account-level GPU soft quota was hit this morning. AWS console shows "Requested vCPU limit increase pending" and GPU-specific limit at hard cap for the region.
matt (oncall): Current numbers: pending requests ~12.2k, queue growth rate ~1800/min, tail latencies spiking > 12s for generation endpoints. Some customers reporting 504s. 
support-eng: Customer impact: support intake shows 24 sessions with degraded responses, 3 labeled P2 (enterprise) with SLAs at risk. Notifying account owners.
ashley (sre): Quick mitigation plan: 1) drain non-critical workspaces to free capacity, 2) enable fallback route to lower-capacity model pool (quantized), 3) request quota increase with cloud-contacts. Executing step 1 now.
matt (oncall): Doing selective pause on background batch jobs: `kubectl label job batch-priority=low && kubectl delete job -l batch-priority=low -n inference` — pausing low-prio queues. 
ashley (sre): Patch for routing: updating router config to prefer eu backups for new requests (for customers allowing multi-region). Deploying canary now.\
matt (oncall): Canary deploy logs: `deploy-router v2 -> canary 5%` — no errors. If canary succeeds, we'll flip traffic. Need approval from sre-lead for wider rollout.
sre-lead: Approved canary expansion to 30% if no errors in 3m. Also confirm that fallback models are within cost budget.
lee (cloud): I filed the support case with AWS support (case #CASE-2026-5478). Asked for emergency GPU quota bump and quoted metrics. Also reached out to partner rep via DM.
support-eng: Sent customer notification draft to account owners: "We are experiencing provisioning delays in ap-east-1 affecting throughput. We are routing to alternate regions and engaging cloud support. Updated ETA within 30 minutes." Waiting on review.
matt (oncall): Observability: stack shows allocator failures: 
```
2026-02-15T09:12:23Z allocator error: AllocateFailed quota_exceeded region=ap-east-1 type=g4dn
2026-02-15T09:13:01Z pending_queue_size=12205 autoscaler_state=backoff
```
ashley (sre): Implemented temporary policy: new requests to hosted-api will attempt cross-region fallback if origin config accepts it. Patch: `routes.fallback.enabled=true`.
matt (oncall): After enabling fallback, pending queue down to 8.3k in 7m. Latency 95p dropped from 12s -> 5.7s. Customers still degraded but improving.
lee (cloud): AWS responded to case: "We see quota at account level; expedite requires justification. We can increase limit within 2-4 hours, otherwise temporary allocation via partner cloud accounts possible." Working the partner option now.
support-eng: Customer comms sent to affected accounts (enterprise owners notified). No guarantees but we're routing traffic and prioritizing critical customers.
matt (oncall): Note: observed some autoscaler thrash where nodes would be requested then immediately refused due to per-zone GPU limit. Adding zone-aware spread reduction to reduce request storms.
ashley (sre): Command we ran to reduce scatter: `PATCH /autoscaler/config {"maxZonesPerRequest":1}`. After patch the request failure rate dropped ~60%.
matt (oncall): Mid-incident handoff: i'm handing to ashley for next hour. I'll unstable-shift into customer comms and followup with account owners. ashley take lead.
ashley (sre): taking lead. Current state summary for handoff: pending 5.9k, fallback routing handling ~45% of new traffic, AWS case open, partner account explored, queued background jobs paused, customer comms live. Next steps: keep fallbacks, pursue partner allocations, prepare rollback if partner route causes cost spike.
cloud-contacts: Update from partner: we can route ~600 GPUs in ap-east-1 via partner tenancy but need signed PO and networking checks. Short-term fill likely in 90-120m assuming approvals.
support-eng: Two customers reported intermittent 504s after fallback due to token routing mismatch; we've opened support side sessions and are applying header-preserve rule to router to fix session affinity.
ashley (sre): Applied header-preserve patch. Quick test for a sample enterprise customer shows stable session, no 504 on 10/10 requests.
matt (oncall): Thanks. Quick checklist for post-mortem capture: root cause = account-level GPU quota exhausted + per-zone hard caps causing autoscaler storms; mitigations = pause low-prio, enable cross-region fallback, zone-request throttling, partner allocation request. Owners: cloud-contacts for quota, ashley for autoscaler config, matt for customer comms.
ashley (sre): We'll also add monitoring alert for cross-region fallback rate > 20% (signal earlier). Filing follow-up ticket: INF-PR-2026-089.
matt (oncall): final update before I drop: partner can provide 600 GPUs if PO approved; AWS quota bump expected 2-4h; queue down to 2.1k. Leaving incident as mitigated but not resolved. If support escalates, re-open pager.
ops-bot: Incident update recorded. Link to incident doc: https://wiki/incidents/INC-2026-234. Severity: Sev2 -> mitigation applied (auto)
ashley (sre): TY everyone. I'll stay on for next 45m then hand to lee for cloud followups.
lee (cloud): continuing partner onboarding. I'll DM account teams for PO signatures. Keep me posted on any new 5xx spikes.
support-eng: will monitor customer tickets and update here. We've scheduled a proactive check-in with affected enterprise accounts in 30m.
matt (oncall): leaving thread. Good work. :thumbsup:
